confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Italian restaurant and hotel pricing and the supplied city context, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant, coffee and wine anchors are more reliable than July hotel rates, which vary widely with events and demand. Cocktail and wine_glass were estimated from the local beer and aperitivo price level, not from direct listings. The FX observation was taken from RBA exchange-rate page content surfaced in search results; I did not open the RBA page directly to confirm the 16 October figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Italian hill-town tourist cities of similar size and visitor profile (for example Lucca, Perugia and Orvieto), adjusted upward for Siena's peak-summer demand and its price level relative to those towns. Florence was used only as an upper reference for accommodation.
